courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: Airbus A350 複材客機系統工程
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 機體尺度、載荷條件、材料方向及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Aircraft scale, load conditions, material direction and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 這門課以公開機型或技術名稱作工程案例入口，再用原創的通用模型檢查負載、能源、量測與驗證。命名案例的實際規格、年代及取證狀態以連結原始機構為準，課內數值均不是原廠資料。
courses.summaryEn: This course uses a public aircraft or technology name as a case-study entry, then original generic models to examine loads, energy, measurement and verification. Consult the linked originating institution for actual specifications, dates and certification status; course numbers are not manufacturer data.

history.title: Airbus A380 雙層客機工程
history.text: 這門課以公開機型或技術名稱作工程案例入口，再用原創的通用模型檢查負載、能源、量測與驗證。命名案例的實際規格、年代及取證狀態以連結原始機構為準，課內數值均不是原廠資料。
history.textEn: This course uses a public aircraft or technology name as a case-study entry, then original generic models to examine loads, energy, measurement and verification. Consult the linked originating institution for actual specifications, dates and certification status; course numbers are not manufacturer data.

courses.connection: 以雙層大型客機為情境，區分樓板集中載荷、增壓殼體、載客分布及分區通風，學習容量放大不等於所有工程量線性放大。十個單元依序進行機制、定量、量測與診斷，每單元可改一個變數比較結果。
courses.connectionEn: For a double-deck large-airliner scenario, separate concentrated floor loads, pressure shell, passenger distribution and ventilation zones; capacity scaling does not make every engineering quantity scale linearly. Ten units each progress through mechanism, calculation, measurement and diagnosis, with a one-variable comparison.
